description: Trafic moyen journalier annuel sur le réseau routier national (2008 à 2018) is a dataset listed in DATA Métropole Aix-Marseille Provence open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Ministère de la transition écologique et solidaire. Précautions d'usage: il a été constaté de fortes variabilités d'une année à l'autre. Les données doivent donc être traitées avec précaution. Pour une analyse plus fine, il est préférable de contacter le producteur: Ce jeu de données a été filtré sur le territoire MAMP à partir du point geo fourni. Coverage: Aix-Marseille-Provence Metropolis. The portal files it under Transports. Its keywords are Mobilité, TMJA, trafic. The portal shows 1,558 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2020-07-27 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-ampmetropole-fr-portal.
